architecture: Mobile Banking App — as implemented in terraform/azure (Phase 1 scaffold)

findings.finding: payment-service role scoped to resource group, not a specific resource
findings.threat: payment-service can reach every resource in the group, not just the one data store it's meant to talk to.
findings.impact: Broader blast radius than necessary if this identity is compromised.
findings.policy: payment-service's role should be scoped to the specific resource it needs.
findings.mitigation: Narrow assignable_scopes to the specific resource ID once it exists.

findings.finding: api-gateway has no WAF/rate-limiting in front of it
findings.threat: api-gateway is directly internet-facing with no layer-7 filtering — vulnerable to L7 DoS and common injection patterns hitting the app directly.
findings.impact: Availability risk and a missing layer of defense against common web attacks.
findings.policy: api-gateway must sit behind a WAF (Azure Application Gateway/Front Door WAF policy).
findings.mitigation: Deploy Azure Front Door or Application Gateway with a WAF policy in front of the gateway subnet.
